Company description: IBM (Generated via gemini-3.1-flash-lite)

International Business Machines Corporation, commonly known as IBM, is a global technology and consulting firm headquartered in Armonk, New York. Founded in 1911 as the Computing-Tabulating-Recording Company and rebranded in 1924, the organization has played a pivotal role in the evolution of modern computing. Throughout its history, IBM has been responsible for landmark innovations, including the development of the mainframe computer, the invention of the floppy disk, and the creation of the IBM PC.

Today, IBM focuses its business operations on hybrid cloud computing, artificial intelligence, and enterprise software. The company provides a comprehensive suite of consulting services and infrastructure solutions designed to help organizations modernize their digital operations and leverage data-driven insights. By prioritizing high-growth areas such as quantum computing and cybersecurity, IBM continues to serve as a foundational partner for global enterprises navigating complex technological transformations. Through its extensive research and development initiatives, the company remains a significant influence in shaping the future of enterprise-grade technology.
